'''Yizhu''' is an NPC in [[Jinzhou]]. Appears at night in front of City Hall.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Yizhu:''' Those cases from yesterday are almost out of time, can't be prosecuted anymore...
:'''Yizhu:''' Hi. What can I help you with?
:{{DIcon}}: Are you a lawyer?
:'''Yizhu:''' I'm sorry, I'm not a lawyer. Generally speaking, the Justice Commission doesn't appoint lawyers for people.
:'''Yizhu:''' And here I am, just a clerk...
:'''Yizhu:''' If you need help with any legal matters, we're here to assist. 
:'''Yizhu:''' What can I assist you with today?
:{{DIcon}}: I'm good, actually. I'll be on my way.
:'''Yizhu:''' Everything's alright? Good to hear.
:'''Yizhu:''' For some reason, things are picking up again.
:'''Yizhu:''' All these case files from the Midnight Rangers need prompt attention...

{{Dialogue End}}
